title: Latest move mapping in fleet lists

effect.user: Fleet lists convert only the selected bees latest move rows.
assertions: Full ordered outputs, latest timestamp/rowid selection and mutation freshness remain unchanged.
SQL statement counts and returned move rows remain unchanged.
exclusions: SQL scanning, latency, CPU, allocation bytes, RSS, full snapshot move registry.

accounts.shared: The handoff workload measures a different projection within the same fleet-list read.

idle.why: No list call means no move mapping.

first-use.why: Database open and fixture setup are excluded.

repeated.why: Each selected list maps fresh latest move state.

scale.why: 1, 8 and 64 bees with 0, 1, 8 or 64 failed move receipts each.

background.why: No runtime or renderer launched by the collector.

release.why: Fixture stores close; no memory measurement.

recovery.why: Behavior tests reopen and replay persisted state.

fixture.seed: Deterministic failed CoreStore move admissions with ties

recipe.readiness: Isolated CoreStore fixture seeded through supported methods
recipe.completion: Fresh list call with full point-read reference parity
recipe.teardown: Close stores and invoke existing test harness cleanup

metrics.scope: Move mappings beyond selected latest moves per fleet list
metrics.collector: Per-instance SQL-result Proxy counts placement_version access at mapBeeMove entry
metrics.invariant: Full ordered outputs equal point reads, no excess mappings, unchanged SQL counts/rows.
metrics.noise: Deterministic operation counts; no timing claim.

gaps: SQL scans all move history; no latency, CPU, allocation or RSS result.
Superseded/unselected malformed move failure JSON stops being decoded by this list; selected latest and full-history reads still fail.
readiness: 144 full-output comparisons across three alternating pairs of 48 cases; zero excess move mappings, unchanged SQL counts and rows. Count-only result.

linked.why: Same list call; outputs and counts replayed after the move mapping change.
Same list call; outputs and counts replayed after the move mapping change.
